seoTitle: Sitemap to CSV Converter (loc, lastmod, images, hreflang)
metaDescription: Convert sitemap XML to CSV with loc, lastmod, changefreq, priority and image, video and hreflang columns. Free, private.
intro: Turns a sitemap into a CSV you can open in a spreadsheet.
why:
A spreadsheet makes it easy to filter sections, sort by date and share lists. Sitemaps are XML, which is not.

Columns for images, videos, hreflang alternates and news fields appear only when the sitemap has them. Fields with commas or quotes are escaped correctly.
howTo: Copy the CSV or download it.

faq.a: Yes, the child sitemaps are listed as rows.
As lang=url pairs separated by spaces.

faq.q: Can I go back to XML?
faq.a: Yes, with the CSV to Sitemap Converter.
